Class TableRows

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.core.settings.TableRows
public final class TableRows extends Object
A table in /tempest (API_VERSION 45): rows the admin adds with "+ Add" and takes out with an X, each with the same few small fields (numbers, tick boxes and words), such as a stall's levels or the rewards for hours played. The setting stays one text value, rows split by ";" and fields by spaces, a tick box as 1 or 0, words with their spaces and semicolons written as %20 and %3B ("_" for none): "2000 1000 1; 6000 10000 0" or "10 give%20{player}%20Gold 1". 
settings.add(Setting.table("Levels", "Level", 2, 10, List.of(
        TableRows.Column.number("Price", 0, 1_000_000, 0),
        TableRows.Column.text("Command", 200, true),
        TableRows.Column.check("Featured")), c::getLevels, c::setLevels));
Check CoreAPI.runningVersion() >= 45 before using it, in a class Main reaches only after that check.
